Ur-Shulgi, The Shepherd
Assamite
Capacity: 11
aus CEL DOM OBF QUI THA
Independent: Ur-Shulgi has 2 votes. If ur-Shulgi is ready during your untap
phase, you may search your library and put Tajdid in your hand. Discard down
to your hand size and shuffle your library afterward. (Blood Cursed)

Before FN, I was asking questions about a silly combo .. Tusk the Talebearer,
Vast Wealth, and an equipment-less deck, to reshuffle as a D action.

In a similar vein, what about Ur-Shulgi? If he's ready during your untap,
and you know you don't have Tajdid (remaining, or at all) in your library,
can you simply choose to reshuffle your library?
